reason: The hypothesis synthesizes separate findings on tribo-oxidation (P2) and micro-galvanic corrosion (P18, P21, P26) into a single synergistic feedback loop for eutectic HEAs under simultaneous wear and corrosion, a coupled degradation mechanism not proposed in any single passage. It also specifies a controlled comparison to isolate the synergy, which goes beyond the separate wear-only and corrosion-only studies in the literature.
